query: INSERT INTO businesses.email_check (member_id, business_id, pick_step_offered_at) SELECT id, business_id, $3 FROM businesses.team_member WHERE id = $1 AND business_id = $2 AND removed_at IS NULL AND confirm_and_billing ON CONFLICT (member_id) DO UPDATE SET pick_step_offered_at = $3 WHERE businesses.email_check.pick_step_offered_at IS NULL RETURNING member_id
